nodes.summary: For a natural number $b \ge 2$, this is the integer polynomial $1 + X + \dots + X^{b-1} = \sum_{i=0}^{b-1} X^i \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$.
nodes.title: Base polynomial of the $b$-nomial coefficients

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $b \ge 2$ and $n$ and an integer $k$, the type-1 $b$-nomial coefficient in row $n$ and column $k$ is the coefficient of $X^k$ in $(1 + X + \dots + X^{b-1})^n \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ when $k \ge 0$, and $0$ when $k < 0$.
nodes.title: Type-1 $b$-nomial coefficients

nodes.summary: For a $b$-ary string $x = (x_0, \dots, x_{n-1})$ of length $n$, written from left to right, and a natural number $j$, this is the digit $x_j$ if $j < n$, and $0$ if $j \ge n$.
nodes.title: Digits of a string extended by zero

nodes.summary: For a $b$-ary string $x$ of finite length, $\iota(x)$ is the number of positions of $x$ that are indispensable.
nodes.title: Number of indispensable digits

nodes.summary: For a natural number $b \ge 2$, a natural number $n$ and an integer $k$, the type-3 $b$-nomial number is the number of $b$-ary strings $x$ of length $n$ with exactly $k$ indispensable digits, that is, with $\iota(x) = k$. In particular it is zero for $k < 0$.
nodes.title: Type-3 b-nomial numbers

nodes.summary: Let $x = (x_0, \dots, x_{n-1})$ be a $b$-ary string of length $n$, written from left to right, and extend it by zero on the right, setting $x_j = 0$ for $j \ge n$. A position $p < n$ is indispensable in $x$ when there is a natural number $r$ with $1 \le r \le n + 1 - p$ such that $x_{p+t} = x_p$ for every $t$ with $1 \le t < r$, and $x_{p+r} < x_p$. nodes.title: Indispensable digits

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
